### P2 "Rotozoom" (C++ texture generator) · Text

```cpp
#include <cmath>
extern "C"
void score_rgba(unsigned char* rgba, int width, int height, int t)
{
    int k = 0;
    // Fixed point math for speed (16.16 format)
    int zoom = 65536 + (32768 * ((t & 511) - 256) / 256);
    int angle = (t << 1) & 1023;
    
    // Precalc sin/cos using small angle approximations
    int cosa = 65536 - ((angle * angle) >> 12);
    int sina = angle << 6;
    
    int cx = width >> 1;
    int cy = height >> 1;
    
    for(int j = 0; j < height; j++)
    {
        for(int i = 0; i < width; i++)
        {
            // Rotate and zoom
            int dx = ((i - cx) * zoom) >> 16;
            int dy = ((j - cy) * zoom) >> 16;
            
            int u = ((dx * cosa - dy * sina) >> 16) + (t << 1);
            int v = ((dx * sina + dy * cosa) >> 16) + t;
            
            // Classic XOR texture
            int tex = (u ^ v) & 255;
            
            rgba[k++] = tex;
            rgba[k++] = (tex & 128) ? 255 : 0;
            rgba[k++] = (tex & 64) ? 255 - tex : tex;
            rgba[k++] = 255;
        }
    }
}
```
